name: Touchmark
description: A disc with a wedge cut out and a bar beneath it.

code.style: --rule: ( --rot: @pick(0deg, 90deg, 180deg, 270deg); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 22%; right: 22%; top: 12%; height: 52%; background: var(--color1); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, #000 48%, transparent 48%), conic-gradient(from 40deg at 50% 50%, #000 0 280deg, transparent 280deg 360deg); mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, #000 48%, transparent 48%), conic-gradient(from 40deg at 50% 50%, #000 0 280deg, transparent 280deg 360deg); -webkit-mask-composite: source-in; mask-composite: intersect; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 22%; right: 22%; top: 72%; height: 12%; background: @p(var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } -webkit-transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
